limitations: This is not torch.compile+outer-CUDA-Graph. The compiled action head cannot be wrapped by a manual outer CUDA Graph because Inductor already performs graph replay internally.
The full VLM/backbone path remains uncapturable in the unmodified official stack due dynamic SigLIP2 indexing.
